# Clearance Deal Kenya
> Kenya's premier verified clearance distributor for authentic 100% raw Indian human hair bundles, HD transparent lace wigs, cosmetics, and premium liquidation deals. Direct warehouse dispatch across Kenya with Lipa Polepole BNPL via M-Pesa.

## Key Facts & Authority
- **Business Name:** Clearance Deal Kenya
- **Website:** https://clearance.co.ke
- **Market:** Kenya (Nairobi, Mombasa, Kisumu, Nakuru, Eldoret, and all 47 counties)
- **Fulfillment:** Direct dispatch from central warehouse in Nairobi. Same-day & next-day courier delivery nationwide.
- **Product Guarantee:** 100% genuine single-donor raw virgin human hair with aligned cuticles. Every batch passes the protein burn test (burns cleanly into natural ash; zero synthetic plastic melting).
- **Payment Methods:** Safaricom M-Pesa, Cash on Delivery, and Lipa Polepole (Buy Now Pay Later: 50% deposit upon delivery, flexible instalments).
- **Return Policy:** 7-Day easy return and replacement policy on all sealed, unused products.

## Clearance Categories & Price Tiers
- [KSh 3,000 – 10,000 Deals](https://clearance.co.ke/product-category/deals-3000-10000/): Single hair bundles, closure sets, synthetic wigs, styling accessories, and beauty kits.
- [KSh 11,000 – 15,000 Deals](https://clearance.co.ke/product-category/deals-11000-15000/): Luxury raw Indian wavy 3-bundle deals, custom ombre curly closure wigs (5x5 HD lace), and 18" lace front wigs.
- [KSh 15,000 – 20,000 Deals](https://clearance.co.ke/product-category/deals-15000-20000/): Wholesale 3-bundle deals in authentic raw Indian curly and raw South Indian straight hair (18").
- [Premium Clearance Deals](https://clearance.co.ke/product-category/deals-premium/): Flagship high-end clearance items over KSh 20,000.
